description:
Reusable EnvNode ESP32 core module including ESP32 DevKitC, board identification
EEPROM (24AA025E48), system I2C connection and associated PCB layout.

The board identification EEPROM is connected to the mandatory EnvNode system
I2C bus on GPIO21 (SDA) and GPIO22 (SCL) and uses I2C address 0x50.

The design block includes the intended component placement and routing for the
processor and board-identification section and is intended for reuse across
ESP32-based EnvNode mainboard variants.
keywords: EnvNode ESP32 DevKitC Core Module Mainboard Board-ID EEPROM EUI-48 I2C 24AA025E48 PCB Layout
